chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Ibn Muskan, from Ibn Abi Yafur, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When the woman performs prostration (sujūd), she should extend her forearms.
ai.seo_question: How should a woman position her arms during prostration in Islamic prayer?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes a distinct juristic ruling for female prostration, emphasizing modesty and anatomical difference by instructing women to extend their forearms rather than keeping them close to the body. This practice highlights the Shia scholarly tradition of deriving specific ritual nuances from the Imams to complement the general Quranic commands for prayer.
